name: deltex E3 ubiquitin ligase 1

function.text: DTX1 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase DTX1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
